speaker: augustine_phillips
text: No song on the green. The verse is done. I am saying it with the palace behind us so nobody decides the dark is a second hall.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am not singing. I can walk without it. The green is only a green.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A fifth, and a bow, and Arthur on the next beat. I am not making a lesson of the path. Sly can have the lesson when there is a sword and a morning.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The bow will keep without a lesson. I saw exact. Exact does not need a companion sentence on a path.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The chair laughed once, kindly. I will not tell it again on a stair. A second telling is how kindly becomes a wage, and there is no wage.

speaker: john_heminges
text: No wage, and no leaf. If my lord is content, a man can bring it in the morning. I am not writing three nights into a book by starlight.

speaker: will_kemp
text: My story is still the inn, down the river. This is not that inn. A green does not qualify. I have held it. I am still holding it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hold it. The button stays lost. I am not paying for this walk with a gold thing we do not have.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Two cloaks, in the morning, counted, with a yeoman looking. Not tonight. A peg is not a witness.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Three of us, one bed, and I want the side I had on Christmas night. I am not negotiating it in the yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have that side. John has the wall. I have the middle, and the middle is not a place for stories.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Arthur is already up. He took the verse as if it were set, and he does not need a praise that would teach him to wait for breaks. Nick, you are with me as far as the stair, and then you are quiet.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Quiet. I am not going to try it against the dark to see what it is now.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Leave it in the hall. Asking him to perform it again would only teach the green to be a stage, and I am finished with stages for tonight.

speaker: will_kemp
text: He bowed well. That is enough for me to say, and I am spending no more of it. My own blanket is the rest of my ambition.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The one Sunday has had its play, and the morning had its prayer, at a table. I am content with the shape. I am not content with a sum, because I have not got one.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Shape is enough to sleep on. Come in. This inn's latch sticks if you are delicate, and I am not delicate.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then be plain with it, and be done. I gave a tale. I stood behind a cloth. I am not measuring the interval again tonight.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Leave it down. Measure it another day. Not on a stair, and not in a bed.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Another day, then. Good night, sir.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good night, Nick. Sly, when there is time. Not before.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Good night. I am done looking at people. Looking was the work, and the work is finished.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Until the inn. I will not say the rest unless one of you starts the button, and I do not advise it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nobody is starting it. God keep you.

speaker: george_bryan
text: And you. The bed is this side of the door. Get to it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am getting to it. Three waits, and the third one is a blanket. I have arrived at the third.
